span.label: The chosen exponent in the weighting function is justified only empirically, not derived.
span.note: what this limits: every result produced with the weighting function: WE OFFER ONLY EMPIRICAL MOTIVATION FOR CHOOSING THE VALUE 3/4 - the exponent is fitted, not derived
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The head-to-head comparison with word2vec is confounded by many performance-affecting parameters.
span.note: what this limits: the head-to-head comparison with word2vec: A RIGOROUS QUANTITATIVE COMPARISON ... IS COMPLICATED BY THE EXISTENCE OF MANY PARAMETERS THAT HAVE A STRONG EFFECT ON PERFORMANCE
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Unspecified parameters were left at defaults, a simplification the authors say a more thorough analysis should relax.
span.note: what this limits: every reported comparison, and it is the confound item 2 names: WE SET ANY UNSPECIFIED PARAMETERS TO THEIR DEFAULT VALUES, ASSUMING THAT THEY ARE CLOSE TO OPTIMAL, THOUGH WE ACKNOWLEDGE THAT THIS SIMPLIFICATION SHO[uld be noted]
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The largest-corpus (840B token) run used a different preprocessing, so its results are not comparable with the reported ones.
span.note: what this limits: the scalability demonstration specifically: TO DEMONSTRATE THE SCALABILITY OF THE MODEL, WE ALSO TRAINED IT ON A MUCH LARGER SIXTH CORPUS, CONTAINING 840 BILLION TOKENS OF WEB DATA, BUT IN THIS [case the conditions differ]
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The comparison that establishes the headline result runs the competing method at default settings, assumed near-optimal, and the paper says the assumption should be relaxed.
span.note: what this limits: the claim that this model outperforms word2vec: unspecified parameters of the compared systems were left at default values on the assumption they are close to optimal, which the authors call a simplification that a more thorough analysis should relax
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The exponent that shapes the weighting function has empirical motivation only.
span.note: what this limits: results that depend on the weighting function: the authors state they offer only empirical motivation for the value 3/4, noting a similar fractional power scaling was found elsewhere
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The distinction the model is built on is declared arbitrary by the authors.
span.note: what this limits: any interpretation of the two vector sets as different kinds of thing: the paper states Quotation withheld and that the two roles may be exchanged
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The largest corpus in the paper was processed differently, so its numbers do not sit on the same scale as the rest.
span.note: what this limits: a comparison across the corpora reported here: for the 840-billion-token web corpus the vocabulary was not lowercased, and the authors state the results are therefore not directly comparable
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The complexity result rests on an assumed distribution rather than a measured one.
span.note: what this limits: the claim about how the model's cost scales: it requires assuming the number of co-occurrences of two words can be modelled as a power-law function of that pair's frequency rank
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: what the paper calls its own object - WORD VECTORS AND WORD REPRESENTATIONS, NEVER EMBEDDINGS: it uses those two terms 24 and 11 times; 'word embeddings' appears exactly once and describes another group's method rather than this paper's output, and 'distributional semantics' does not appear at all
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: 'word embeddings' IN THIS PAPER - SOMEONE ELSE'S OBJECT: the single occurrence attributes the term to Levy et al., alongside vLBL and ivLBL, as a rival PPMI-based approach; the authors never apply the word to what they themselves produce
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the analogy evaluation - AS DIMENSIONS OF DIFFERENCE, NOT DISTANCE: it probes the vector space by examining the various dimensions of difference between vectors rather than the scalar distance between them, which is why a model can win on similarity and lose on analogy
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the context window - SYMMETRIC OR ASYMMETRIC, AND THE CHOICE MOVES ONE SUBTASK ONLY: a window extending both ways is called symmetric and one extending only left asymmetric, and the syntactic subtask specifically improves with small asymmetric windows
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
